sources.notes: 末端轨迹精度是控制/标定/学习三条线的交叉词，静态分类法（last-centimeter 偏最后接近段）覆盖不足；Agent 依据机器人学控制文献常规术语推断动态扩展。

queries.label: dynamic-trajectory-tracking-control
queries.why: 末端轨迹精度的直接文献用语是 trajectory tracking，控制类论文标题高频。

queries.label: dynamic-end-effector-accuracy
queries.why: 直接命中以末端执行器精度为题的论文。

queries.label: dynamic-positioning-accuracy-compensation
queries.query: all:"positioning accuracy" AND all:compensation AND all:robot
queries.why: 工业机器人绝对定位精度补偿是解决方案主文献线。

queries.label: dynamic-kinematic-calibration
queries.why: 运动学标定是提升末端精度的经典机制层方案。

queries.label: dynamic-dynamic-parameter-identification
queries.why: 动力学参数辨识支撑模型基控制补偿。

queries.label: dynamic-friction-compensation
queries.why: 摩擦是轨迹跟踪误差的高频来源，补偿文献密集。

queries.label: dynamic-mpc-robot
queries.why: MPC 是近年轨迹级精度控制主流方案之一。

queries.label: dynamic-disturbance-observer
queries.query: all:"disturbance observer" AND all:robot AND all:manipulator
queries.why: 扰动观测器针对未建模动态造成的跟踪误差。

queries.label: dynamic-iterative-learning-control
queries.why: ILC 面向重复轨迹任务消除跟踪误差。

queries.label: dynamic-residual-dynamics-learning
queries.query: all:"residual dynamics" AND all:learning AND all:robot
queries.why: 学习残差动力学再叠加模型控制是近年混合方案主线。

queries.label: dynamic-vibration-suppression
queries.why: 柔性/振动直接破坏末端轨迹精度。

queries.label: elastic-joint-control
queries.why: 谐波减速器弹性关节是跟踪误差的机制层痛点。

queries.label: dynamic-learning-tracking-error
queries.query: all:"tracking error" AND all:"neural network" AND all:robot
queries.why: 学习法消除跟踪误差的论文与痛点的实证来源。

queries.label: dynamic-action-chunking-smoothness
queries.query: all:"action chunking" AND (all:smooth OR all:jerk OR all:oscillation)
queries.why: VLA/ACT 动作分块带来的末端抖动是学习侧轨迹精度痛点。

queries.label: dynamic-lowlevel-control-vla
queries.why: VLA 与底层轨迹控制器的接口是近年精度讨论热点。

queries.label: dynamic-diffusion-policy-tracking
queries.why: 扩散策略输出轨迹与跟踪控制器组合的精度证据。

queries.label: dynamic-whole-body-control
queries.why: 全身控制把任务空间轨迹精度下沉到全身关节。

queries.label: dynamic-visual-servoing-precision
queries.why: 视觉伺服用感知闭环补偿末端轨迹偏差。

queries.label: dynamic-iso9283-path-accuracy
queries.why: ISO 9283 规定轨迹精度/重复性的评测口径。

queries.label: dynamic-sim2real-tracking
queries.query: all:"sim-to-real" AND all:"tracking control" AND all:robot
queries.why: sim-to-real 控制差距以跟踪精度为度量的证据。

queries.label: dynamic-backlash-gear
queries.why: 传动间隙是精度痛点的硬件层语言。

queries.label: dynamic-rl-tracking-control
queries.query: all:"reinforcement learning" AND all:"tracking control" AND all:robot
queries.why: RL 直接学习跟踪控制器近年证据线。

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-trajectory-precision-browser
browser_fallback_queries.why: 检查 arXiv 元数据之外是否有工业侧讨论。

browser_fallback_queries.label: dynamic-vla-jitter-browser
browser_fallback_queries.query: VLA action chunking jitter smoothing low-level control 2026
browser_fallback_queries.why: 学习侧末端抖动痛点的社区讨论校准。

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-trajectory-accuracy-terms
web_calibration_queries.query: "trajectory tracking accuracy" robot manipulator compensation survey
web_calibration_queries.why: 校准轨迹精度领域当前术语。

web_calibration_queries.label: dynamic-absolute-accuracy-repeatability
web_calibration_queries.why: 确认绝对精度 vs 重复性术语仍在使用。
